definitions.explanation: Body coloring that lets an animal blend into its surroundings so that predators or prey cannot easily see it. A biology term, also used figuratively for anything that helps someone go unnoticed.

examples.japanese: カメレオン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保護色|ほごしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{葉|は}っぱ→葉っぱ：05388_happa⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{保護色|ほごしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This insect has protective coloration the same as the leaves.
In the snow, white fur becomes protective coloration and protects them from enemies.

notes:
A biology term for coloring that camouflages an animal against its background. Contrast with {警告色|けいこくしょく} (warning coloration), which makes an animal conspicuous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保護色|ほごしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: to have protective coloration
- {保護色|ほごしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as camouflage
- ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保護色|ほごしょく}: camouflage matching the surroundings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {迷彩|めいさい}: camouflage pattern — man-made, as on military uniforms and vehicles
- ⟦{擬態|ぎたい}→擬態：29905_gitai⟧: mimicry — imitating another object or creature in shape as well as color
